headline: SpaceX and Tesla are studying a merger that would pool over 30,000 BTC, and the first final US stablecoin rule under the GENIUS Act landed today.

stories.title: SpaceX and Tesla look at a merger that would combine more than 30,000 Bitcoin
stories.summary: On SpaceX's earnings call on Tuesday 20 Oct, Elon Musk said SpaceX and Tesla have set up special committees to study a merger. Together the two companies hold 30,221 BTC. No deal terms have been agreed. Tesla reports its own earnings after the US close today.
points: Reported holdings: 18,712 BTC at SpaceX and 11,509 BTC at Tesla, 30,221 BTC combined (about $2.5B, per CoinDesk).
Musk: "The special committees have not reached agreement on the terms of any transaction." He added that shareholders would have to support it.
SpaceX Q3 revenue was $14.58B against a $12.7B estimate. Its shares were up about 9% before the US open.
Tesla and Meta both report after today's US close (about 03:30-04:30 Thursday, Bangkok time).

sources.label: CoinDesk: SpaceX and Tesla explore merger

stories.title: First final US stablecoin rule is out, and it leaves stablecoin 'rewards' in a grey zone
stories.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), a US bank regulator, issued the first final rule under the GENIUS Act stablecoin law on 21 Oct. It sets how banks and other firms can get approval to issue dollar stablecoins. On rewards paid to stablecoin holders, the OCC will judge case by case instead of approving or banning them outright.
points: The rule takes effect on 18 Jan 2027.
The OCC says it "declines to presume" that rewards programs from before the GENIUS Act comply. An OCC official said "if we see a clear evasion, then we could pursue it."
CoinDesk names reward programs now under the spotlight: PayPal's PYUSD (4%), Coinbase One on USDC (3.75%) and Kraken+ on USDG (up to 4.5%).
Reserves must meet minimum daily liquidity rules and limits on relying on a single counterparty.

stories.title: Bitcoin reaches a one-week high near $83.4K as ETF inflows cool and oil stays near $110
stories.summary: Bitcoin rose about 2.5% to a one-week high, and Ether rose more. Money going into US spot Bitcoin ETFs slowed sharply on Tuesday after Monday's big day. Brent oil hit almost $112 on Tuesday before easing.
points: Prices at about 11:15 UTC (18:15 Bangkok), per CoinDesk: BTC about $83,449 (+2.5%), ETH about $2,467 (+3.6%).
US spot Bitcoin ETFs took in a net $23.16M on 20 Oct (SoSoValue data via TokenPost), down from $526.7M on 19 Oct (Ted Pillows report).
Ether ETFs lost $26.13M on 20 Oct, their fifth straight day of outflows.
Brent oil peaked at $111.99 on 20 Oct and settled at $108.79.
Strategy (MSTR) bought 267 more BTC for $22.1M and now holds 848,517 BTC.

briefs.title: Solana's Alpenglow upgrade is due within hours
briefs.summary: The consensus switch happens at slot 459,653,000. Anza puts it at about 14:00 UTC today (21:00 Bangkok); the Solana Foundation's 13:20 UTC is the start of epoch 1064.

briefs.title: Trump to spotlight the crackdown on overseas crypto scams
briefs.summary: The FBI's IC3 logged over $11B in crypto-related losses in 2025; people aged 60 and over lost about $7.7B.

briefs.title: Zcash (ZEC) up about 11% after its NU7 upgrade got a date
briefs.summary: Developers set a November activation date for NU7, which cuts block times from 75 to 25 seconds.

briefs.title: Qubic restarts its network after a $1.4M wallet exploit
briefs.summary: A weak random-number generator for wallet seeds hit 1,404 accounts. Wallet v4.26.4 fixes it and claims are open until 1 May 2027.

briefs.title: NEAR up about 6% on a plan to cut new token issuance
briefs.summary: A governance proposal would cut NEAR's yearly issuance from 2.5% to 1.6% over two years.

briefs.title: UK inflation rose to 3.5%
briefs.summary: UK CPI rose 3.5% in the 12 months to September, up from 3.1%.
